description.name: WHMCS DNS
description.tagline: DNS hosting and management for WHMCS domains.
description.long: Manage DNS zones and records directly from WHMCS using multiple DNS providers. The module integrates DNS provisioning with the WHMCS domain lifecycle and provides customers with DNS zone and record management from the client area.
features: Manage DNS zones and records from WHMCS
Allow customers to manage DNS from the client area
Enable or disable DNS hosting per domain
Support multiple DNS providers through PlexDNS
Integrate DNS provisioning with the WHMCS domain lifecycle
